messages:
Jules (SRE): pasting postmortem link + quick ask: https://redwood.pm/postmortem/2828-region-flap. TL;DR: during an EU control-plane blip we saw 1) stale route bindings, 2) slowed snapshot restores (p95 restore > 40s), 3) KV divergence on partial restores. I'm trying to convert the follow-ups into narrow, actionable tickets we can close before next game day.
Priya (Backup): Thanks. I noticed our restore path lacks a fast integrity-check step after restore returns. We only have a full-data-check that runs for hours. Need a small smoke check.
Marco (Routing): We also lack structured reasons in the routing logs. When a route falls back, operator saw only "fallback=true" with no cause. Suggest: add "fallback_reason" and propagate region_hint.
Tess (Product Ops): Customer-impact summary: several EU customers saw 5xx spikes for ~6m. We should include a short customer blurb and the remediation timeline in the weekly status. I can draft if we set dates.
Ben (Eng): Propose split of work: (1) smoke-verify script + CI (owner: Ben), (2) routing log fields + trace header (owner: Marco), (3) backup retention audit + policy doc (owner: Priya), (4) scheduled restore game-day + runbook rehearse (owner: Jules/Tess).
Jules (SRE): Love the split. Quick acceptance criteria suggestions: smoke-verify returns HTTP 200 on /health and confirms expected key count > 0; routing logs must show fallback_reason in >= 95% of fallback cases; runbook must include a one-line "proof of restore" step.
Priya (Backup): I'll take (3). I'll run a quick retention scan and propose policy changes. Target: create PR with recommendations by 2026-03-25.
Marco (Routing): I'll take (2). Will add header X-RDW-TRACE and new field fallback_reason. RFC + minimal shim by 2026-03-18.
Ben (Eng): I'll own (1). I'll add verify_restore.sh and a weekly CI cron job. ETA 2026-03-22.
Tess (Product Ops): I'll draft the customer blurb; aim EOD 2026-03-20. Will say: "incident impacted EU customers for ~6 minutes; we have added runbook checks and scheduled a restore dry-run."
Jules (SRE): I'll coordinate the game-day with on-call. Proposed slot Fri 2026-04-10 14:00 UTC. schedule-bot can create the calendar. Also please add alerting: create metric restore.p95.latency and alert if >30s for 5m.
schedule-bot: Calendar event created: Restore Game-day Dry Run — Fri 2026-04-10 14:00 UTC (owner: Jules).
ticket-bot: Created RDW-4501 verify-restore-smoke (assignee: Ben, due: 2026-03-22).
ticket-bot: Created RDW-4502 routing-fallback-reasons (assignee: Marco, due: 2026-03-18).
ticket-bot: Created RDW-4503 backup-retention-audit (assignee: Priya, due: 2026-03-25).
Jules (SRE): I'll open a lightweight tracker doc and link tickets: https://redwood.docs/trackers/2828-flap-docket. Please paste acceptance tests in ticket bodies and ping me when tests are green.
Marco (Routing): Will add trace header preservation tests to our e2e proxy suite.
Ben (Eng): CI job will emit a dashboard panel and post a weekly status to the tracker.
Tess (Product Ops): Reminder: include the "we will run a dry-run within 3 weeks" line in the blurb.
Priya (Backup): One more thing: let's confirm snapshot consistency across regions by adding an incremental checksum step to replication. I'll include that in my PR.
Jules (SRE): Closing note: pattern to watch = "stale route binding + slow partial restore". If seen 2 more times escalate to resilience epic. For now, deliverables + dates above. I'll run a 10m sync tomorrow to clear blockers. :thumbsup:
